content.short: Foxify is a perpetuals and P2P options trading platform.
content.description: Foxify offers perpetual contracts with up to 50x leverage and peer-to-peer options, enabling users to act as makers or takers in a decentralized environment. The platform prioritizes a user-first experience for traders while delivering DeFi-style options for investors seeking structured exposure and flexible risk management, uniting perpetuals with peer-to-peer option trading to support diverse strategies within a decentralized setting.
content.meta: Foxify offers perpetuals with up to 50x leverage and options that are P2P. Discover Foxify and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
